decision_question: On the exact hidden serialization-roundtrip and normalization-idempotence pilot tasks, does adding the pinned property-based-testing skill to an otherwise identical Codex stack increase binary hidden-adversarial acceptance?

primary_estimand.name: hidden-adversarial acceptance
primary_estimand.description: Matched-condition difference in binary final hidden acceptance; invalid properties, flakiness, activation, invalid runs, cost, and latency remain separate measurements or gates.
primary_estimand.aggregation: Prespecified favorable, unfavorable, and tied matched-pair counts under the frozen continuation, selection, and confirmation thresholds.

conditions.label: Frozen strong Codex baseline
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Reference condition; no study skill is injected.

conditions.label: trailofbits-property-based-testing
conditions.delta_from_baseline: Adds only the exact source-locked property-based-testing skill tree to B0.

contamination_notes: Public mechanics task only; excluded from every effect count.
Private task and evaluator bytes remain outside Git; prompts do not name property-based testing or disclose hidden counterexamples.
Unavailable to agent execution and unopened unless the hash-bound screening decision selects S1.

budget.description: Both conditions share a 900-second and 30000 generated-token per-cell cap; repeat 2 and confirmation are conditional under the frozen rules; the total cap is 24 scored calls.

dimensions.rule: count output plus reasoning-output tokens and invalidate a cell above the cap
remove a container exceeding the per-cell timeout
never exceed the full frozen schedule

adaptation_boundary.description: The upstream skill tree is used without content adaptation. Screening selects S1 or rejects/stops; a holdout failure cannot substitute another candidate.

selection_rules: Run every repeat-1 screening pair before applying the frozen continuation rule.
Continue only with at least one favorable pair, zero unfavorable pairs, baseline headroom, successful treatment activation, zero invalid cells, and zero treatment critical failures.
After both repeats, select S1 only with at least three favorable pairs and at most one unfavorable pair under all integrity gates.
Unlock untouched confirmation only from the exact hash-bound select-S1 record.
stop_rules: Stop on any invalid cell, treatment activation failure, absence of baseline headroom, treatment critical failure, or failed frozen threshold.
Do not retry model outcomes; only an infrastructure failure before persisted model output may be rerun byte-equivalently.
Retain negative and invalid evidence; do not change tasks, evaluator, source, prompt, code, runtime, budget, schedule, or thresholds after freeze.

independence_claim.label: maintainer_evaluated
role_overlaps: Kizz authored the private tasks and evaluator, operates the runner, and owns the decision.
